Flexbox axes
Direction decides the axes.

justify-content and align-items
Justify = main; align = cross.

flex-grow, shrink and basis
Basis starts; grow adds; shrink reduces.

CSS Grid tracks and areas
Tracks = rows and columns; areas = named regions.

Flexbox vs Grid
Flex = one axis; Grid = two axes.

Media queries and breakpoints
Condition true = rules apply.

Mobile-first design
Small first, enhance later.

Responsive images
Fit the box; choose the source.

Fluid layouts
Fluid grows, max caps.

Transforms
Transform moves the picture, not the slot.

Centering elements
Grid place-items:center = two axes.

CSS reset
Reset defaults, not accessibility.

Cross-browser compatibility
Fallback first; enhance safely.

Container queries
Query the component, not the screen.

CSS Grid auto-fit vs auto-fill
Fill keeps slots; fit collapses empty slots.
